notable.name: Jamaican Patois
notable.note: the everyday vernacular for most of the population, structurally distinct from standard English

terrainDescription.zh: 中東部有藍山山脈與雲霧雨林，沿海多沙灘與珊瑚礁，內陸丘陵地形起伏明顯。
terrainDescription.en: The Blue Mountains and cloud rainforest dominate the east-central interior, with sandy/coral coastline and markedly hilly inland terrain.

historicalContext.zh: 牙買加曾為英國殖民地，靠左行駛，官方語言為英語，但日常口語以牙買加土語（Patois，英語詞彙基礎的克里奧語）為主，兩者文法結構差異明顯；路牌設計融合美式（MUTCD）與歐式（維也納公約）標誌系統，並非單一標準。
historicalContext.en: A former British colony that drives on the left; English is official, but everyday speech is dominated by Jamaican Patois, an English-lexified Creole with a grammar structurally distinct from standard English. Road signage blends American (MUTCD) and European (Vienna Convention) sign systems rather than following a single standard.
